description: List EVERY document in one SEC filing by accession number — the primary document, each exhibit, XML and XBRL files, graphics — with seq, type (e.g. "8-K", "EX-99.1"), description, size in bytes, `stored` and `secUrl`. Also returns the filing's cik, companyName, formType, filingDate, acceptedAt, bodyStored, primaryDocument, indexUrl, and `filingId`. HOW TO READ A DOCUMENT: if it has an `exhibitId`, call get_exhibit_content with that id; for the whole submission text call get_filing_document with `filingId`. `exhibitId: null` means the document has no readable text row here (XML/XBRL/graphics, or text not held) — open its `secUrl`. When `readableIdsResolved` is false the id lookup failed and exhibitId is omitted (not "none"); get_filing_exhibits(filingId) lists them. `stored: false` means Signal8 holds the filing record but not that document's body — it exists on EDGAR at `secUrl`. A filing not held in the archive returns a not-found error; its documents are still on EDGAR. Coverage: Signal8's archive of SEC EDGAR filings in the archive's held range (see `archiveFrom` in each response; currently from late 2021, expanding back to 2016 as the history backfill fills in), updated through the day. The archive only holds filings from its `archiveFrom` date; before that it holds only a scatter (well under 1% of most years), so ABSENCE BEFORE archiveFrom IS NOT EVIDENCE a filing was never filed — check SEC EDGAR for earlier periods. Some rows are record-only (bodyStored: false — metadata from the EDGAR index with no document body), so their text cannot be read here; open them at their sec.gov URL.

accessionNumber.description: SEC accession number, dashed ("0001193125-22-010026") or 18-digit compact form
